comment: Generated by dsh-market scripts/sync-arya-sources.mjs from arya-plugins.json (channel "market"). Do not edit by hand: change the manifest and re-run the generator.

description.en: A real mail panel for the Outlook you are already signed into: folders, multi-select, a safe HTML reading pane, replies that stay drafts in the harness, a draft card in the chat and a draft tab beside it. No Azure app registration, no admin consent.
description.zh: 为已登录的 Outlook 装上真正的邮件面板：文件夹、多选列表、安全的 HTML 阅读、留在 harness 里的回复草稿、聊天中的草稿卡片，以及并排的草稿侧栏。无需 Azure 应用注册，无需管理员授权。

description.en: AryaCode Polish: one install for the small things that make AryaCode feel finished. One Plugins row, one switch per quality-of-life feature.
description.zh: AryaCode 润色：一次安装，补齐让 AryaCode 更顺手的小细节。一个插件行，每个体验功能一个开关。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: drives apps through accessibility controls instead of pixels, frames the window it is driving, marks each action with a ghost cursor, and stops on Esc; a browser lane adds sign-in profiles and attach-to-my-Chrome.
description.zh: Windows 电脑操控：用辅助功能接口而不是像素驱动应用，只框住正在操作的窗口，用虚拟光标标出每步动作，按 Esc 立即停止；另有一条浏览器通道，支持登录配置与接入你自己的 Chrome。
